name: memory-graph
description: Memória de projeto num vault Obsidian — escrita pelo obsidian CLI, recall semântico + travessia de [[links]] 100% on-device (fastembed + sqlite-vec), zero nuvem. Traz as skills memory-vault (protocolo diário) e memory-vault-setup (criação do vault + migração da memória legada).

MEMORY_GRAPH_DIR.title: Vault directory
MEMORY_GRAPH_DIR.description: Optional. Absolute path to the Obsidian vault (the directory that contains .obsidian/). Auto-detected from the project when empty.

MEMORY_GRAPH_DB.title: Index database path
MEMORY_GRAPH_DB.description: Optional. Absolute path to the SQLite index. Auto-detected per project when empty.
